title: How do rooms and projects contain and own one another?
question: How do rooms and projects contain and own one another?
answer: TT-Q3: A Workbench is a 'room' that holds many Workbenches and many Projects; each Project has exactly one Workbench of its own. A Workbench is one set of Contract and routing artifacts with one Blueprint. A Blueprint has many Specs and many Tasks; a Spec has many Tasks and many Chats; a Task maps to one Chat. Spec is the destination, Task the steps; small work may be a standalone Task.
